rig: Running sinker or paternoster, 40-60lb leader, 5/0-7/0 octopus or suicide hooks; berley pot/cube trail
habitat: reef edges, hard bottom, mud/sand patches near reef
where: Frankston-Olivers Hill 14-22 m, Mornington 16-24 m grounds, Mt Martha deep water, Mordialloc-Black Rock off Ricketts
tips: Spring run peaks Nov-Dec; dawn/dusk and the tide change fish best. Berley steadily. In the eastern bay the run usually tails off about a week before Christmas.

habitat: sand/mud with scattered reef, channel edges
where: Carrum to Mordialloc 8-14 m, Frankston, Mornington, Safety Beach
tips: Pinkies school over broad areas in summer-autumn; drift or anchor and berley.

rig: Two-hook paternoster, 8-12lb fluoro, 4/0 long-shank (size 6-4) hooks, small ball sinker
habitat: sand patches within weed (seagrass) beds, channels
where: Carrum-Mordialloc 4-8 m, Safety Beach-Dromana-Rosebud flats, Mt Martha shallows, Mornington
tips: Drift the sand holes on a slow tide; berley light with pipi/pilchard. Best early morning and late afternoon.

rig: Squid jig on 10-15lb braid, 15lb fluoro; drift or cast-and-slow-retrieve
habitat: weed (seagrass) beds, reef edges, pier pylons
where: Mt Martha, Mornington harbour & pier, Safety Beach, Dromana, Frankston Pier edge; Mordialloc shallows
tips: Calm, clear water over weed. Dawn/dusk and slack tide. Autumn big females and spawning in spring.

rig: Paternoster or running sinker with 30-40lb leader, drift slowly
habitat: sand edges, mud, sand next to reef or weed
where: Carrum, Mordialloc, Aspendale 5-10 m; Safety Beach, Rosebud; Mornington
tips: Drift with the wind over clean sand; lift-and-drop plastics.

rig: Heavy bottom rig with ganged hooks, 60-80lb mono/wire, large sinker, fresh bait
where: Mornington, Mt Martha deeper water, off Frankston
tips: Fish after dark or at dusk; anchor with fresh oily baits.

rig: Cast and retrieve fast, light spin outfit, light wire trace
habitat: sand, reef edges, surface in schools
where: Frankston Pier edge, Mornington, Mt Martha, Safety Beach, Carrum
tips: Look for working birds and surface boils; run a lure fast. Good bait for snapper/gummy.

rig: Float or light paternoster, tiny hooks (long shank, size 10-12), 4lb leader
habitat: weed edges, pier pylons, shallow sand
where: Frankston Pier, Mornington Pier/harbour, Mt Martha, Mordialloc
tips: Berley with bread or garfish berley mix; winter-early spring best.

rig: Light running sinker or paternoster, 15-20lb fluoro, size 4/0 hooks
habitat: reef edge, pier pylons, mixed sand/weed
tips: Often found among pylons and rocky patches; berley.

rig: Small paternoster, short wire/fluoro leader with small hooks (size 4)
where: Frankston artificial reef (offshore), Mornington reefs, Mt Martha
tips: Fish close to bottom; bite is subtle. Hooks small; bag limit 10 (check).

rig: Paternoster on bottom with fresh bait, 30lb leader
where: Mordialloc to Frankston deeper channels, Mornington — mostly a western-bay (Werribee/Corio) fish; a bonus in the east.
tips: Winter-spring visitor; fresh bait at night. Mulloway: low odds in this area; check bag limits. Treat as bonus.
